claim_summary: For the ordinary four-row seven-column chessboard complex \(\Delta_{4,7}\), the order-fourteen dihedral group \(D_7\) acts on the seven cyclic column labels by rotations and reflections while fixing the rows. Its geometric orbit space \(Q=|\Delta_{4,7}|/D_7\) has the complete integral homotopy type \[Q\simeq\bigvee^{3}M(\mathbb Z/2,2)\vee\bigvee^{15}S^3.\] Thus \(\pi_1(Q)=0\), \(\pi_2(Q)\cong H_2(Q;\mathbb Z)\cong(\mathbb Z/2)^3\), and \(H_3(Q;\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z^{15}\), with no other nonzero reduced homology. The source complex itself is \(\bigvee^{225}S^3\). An exact orbit-of-barycentric-flags cellular model has ranks \((142,1236,2520,1440)\) and an integer chain-equivalent reduction with cells \((1,0,3,18)\) and three nonzero Smith factors \(2,2,2\) in the remaining third boundary. The standard two-connectivity theorem for \(\Delta_{4,7}\), Armstrong fixed-element fundamental-group theorem, and classification of attachments in simply connected three-dimensional CW complexes upgrade these chain data to the stated homotopy equivalence. No result for other board widths or a different symmetry group is asserted.
scientific_integrity: Exact signed integral chain enumeration and unit-pivot reductions with all minors computed by a standalone standard-library checker; theorem-based fundamental group and homotopy classification are separately supplied; computational and theoretical limits are stated.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary full dihedral quotient by the seven-column action is classified; no claim for other board widths. The classical connectivity and group orbit-space theorems are prior results. Literature overlap screening is not a universal uniqueness test, and independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
title: Three Moore summands in the seven-column dihedral chessboard quotient
